description.p: An unofficial desktop port of Aegis Authenticator, not affiliated with or endorsed by Beem Development. It generates the one-time codes used for two-factor authentication and stores them in an encrypted vault on your own machine.
The vault format is the same one Aegis for Android uses, so a single vault file can be kept in sync between a phone and a desktop by whatever means you already trust.
Aegis makes no network connections. Nothing in your vault leaves the machine unless you export it yourself.
